W35.04-C1.basis: Distinct grant IDs separate same-profile/same-second devices. Serialized detach removes only the presented active grant and closes its sockets, while keeping peer authority and exact shared behavioral state. Durable prepared/complete receipt binds original grant, epoch and operation; persisted replacement timestamps are not renewed. Completed recovery requires durable source authority and existing-only replacement activation. Current/refined refusal is intersected again and persisted on source/replacement. Actual grouped case passes ambiguous commit/restart recovery, peer reads/manual effects, source refusal tightening and refusal to resurrect a reset replacement.

W35.04-C2.basis: Target transfer puts profile, receipt, authoritative membership, consent and recognized grant together. Retry validates the receipt-bound active grant; routes sign its original descriptor instead of reminting. Reset/internal erase/retention list/delete prior keys, replace the epoch and delete the alarm inside one transaction, with no deleteAll-to-barrier window. Warm mirrors invalidate and sockets close on success or ambiguity. Completed reset recovery rejects missing/corrupt source authority; cold adoption rejects transition/receipt/barrier state and never creates a missing grant within an existing authority. Actual cases cover interrupted and committed-but-unacknowledged cleanup, restart, old recognized/source replay rejection and fresh bootstrap.

W35.04-C3.basis: Signed HTTP ingest/read/manual/consent/export/absorb/forward/health/reset doors either invoke assertOwned/assertGrant inside serialization or take the explicit exact transition-recovery path. Buffered authorization precedes rate accounting. Socket upgrade, action, heartbeat and synchronous pushes use current stored authority; deferred ODP receipt push re-enters serialization. Hibernated attachments are rechecked rather than trusted by signature alone. Actual grouped case orders an in-flight mutation before detach and proves revoked socket/action/buffered/read denial with a functioning peer. Legacy bearer session-host positive and DO negative pass. Both-host withdrawal/SDK continuity and W35.03 transfer/refusal cases pass. Explicit issueSessionCapability clock is retained; persisted-descriptor signing validates against current time without renewal.

transaction_api_review.basis: Installed transaction interface exposes list, delete, put and deleteAlarm.
